title: On the Identifiability of Mixed Ordinal and Exponential Family Causal DAGs under Linear Parametric Models
summary: The problem of identifiability in linear parametric models (LPMs) whose nodes follow either an ordered logit model or a regular one-parameter exponential family is evaluated. The results go beyond classical structural equation models as well as results for nodes with observations from a homogeneous family of distributions.
